notes:
- Customer: mid-market e‑commerce personalization/search vendor. Wants faster reranking and semantic search across product catalogs.
- Strong technical interest: prefers model routing + low-cost quantized variants for bulk batch rerank jobs; target p95 latency < 120ms for live search.
- Security: must have SSO/SAML, audit logs for token usage, and EU data residency for EU customer subset.
- Operational ask: ability to pin model versions and run canary rollouts per region.
- Sales context: AE did two architecture sessions with SE (Ethan). SE produced prelim capacity estimate ~4 GPUs for 200 req/s peak.
- POC: planned to validate reranking latency and ranking quality vs. current in-house solution. Success criteria were never finalized — product wanted end-to-end SLA and evaluation dataset; infra wanted cost cap.
- What went wrong: procurement & headcount freeze in Nov; internal champion (Head of Search) promoted out in Dec and not replaced; competing vendor (Anthropic partner) offered a flexible deferred-payment contract and faster legal terms; Stonebridge asked us to pause.
- Quotes: "We like the perf numbers but can't commit headcount during the freeze." — Head of Product
- Open items: unresolved security questionnaire items (encryption-at-rest KMS workflow), final SOW, and data residency proof for EU customers.
- Next recommended cadence: Document handoff to Customer Success for passive nurture; re-engage after Sep 2026 budget window. Consider offering a limited free evaluation tier or extended trial to win back when budget reopens.
company_description: Stonebridge Customer Intelligence builds search and personalization tooling for e-commerce marketplaces. Focus on catalog ranking, user intent signals, and ML-based personalization.
closed_reason_detail: POC never started — couldn't align on success criteria / resourcing. Procurement froze spend; internal champion left. Competitor offered more attractive commercial terms. Security questionnaire outstanding.
sales_play_notes: Tried pricing concession and extended trial in Nov; legal turnaround time for competitor was faster. Recommend re-target as 'warm-nurture' and prioritize EU data residency proof if re-engaged.
